content: Hello, this is Alex from Amazon Order Support. I see you recently contacted us about a problem with your delivery. I'd like to help resolve this for you today.
Hi, yes, I haven't received my package and I'm not sure what happened. I got an email saying there was an issue.
I completely understand how frustrating that can be, and I'm here to sort this out. May I have your full name and the email associated with your Amazon account to verify your order?
My name is Jordan Smith, and my email is jordansmith88@gmail.com.

Thank you, Jordan. I'm now pulling up your order details. I see your package is being held due to a new customs regulation for online shipments. It's something Amazon is working hard to address for our customers.
Oh, I didn't know about that. Is there something I have to do?

Yes, but don't worry, I'm here to guide you. According to the latest regulations, a temporary customs fee of $74.50 needs to be paid before the package can be released and delivered. This is a mandatory policy for all international shipments right now.
Um, I wasn't expecting to pay more. Is this really from Amazon?

Absolutely, Jordan. I understand your concern. As a supervisor, I can assure you this is a standard procedure, and Amazon will fully refund you once the package clears customs. All details are handled securely.
Okay, I just want to make sure my order gets here. How do I pay the fee?

Of course. For your convenience, Amazon accepts the customs fee through Amazon gift card codes, which are processed instantly. This is the fastest and safest method while customs is experiencing delays.
So, I just buy a gift card and send you the code?
Exactly, Jordan. If you purchase an Amazon gift card for $74.50 from any retailer or online, just send me the redemption code. I'll process it immediately and confirm your delivery.
Alright. Where do I send the code once I buy it?
You can simply reply to this chat with the code, and I'll take care of the rest for you. I'll wait while you get it.
Okay, I'll go buy a card now. Is there a certain store I need to use?
You can get Amazon gift cards at almost any grocery store, pharmacy, or online at amazon.com/giftcard. Just make sure the total is $74.50.
Alright, I'll go to Walgreens. Should I just scratch off the back and send you the number?
Yes, that's perfect. Once you have the code, type it here and I'll submit it to our customs processing portal. I'll stay with you every step.
Okay, I'll let you know once I have it. How long will it take for my package to arrive after?
Usually within 24 to 48 hours after the customs fee is cleared. I'll also send you a confirmation email as soon as it's processed.
And I'll get the $74.50 back?
Yes, absolutely. Amazon will refund the customs charge to your original payment method. If you have any questions, I'm right here to help.
Okay, heading out now to get the card.
Thank you, Jordan. I appreciate your cooperation. Just let me know when you're ready, and we'll get your order on its way.
